# DreamLedger

DreamLedger is a New Zealand website with free evidence-checking tools, supplier quote comparison, and selected digital products.

## Start here
- Home: https://dreamledger.org/
- Free Truth Oracle: https://dreamledger.org/truth-oracle.html
- Free evidence guide: https://dreamledger.org/truth-oracle-field-guide.html
- Supplier quote comparison: https://dreamledger.org/quote-comparison/
- Services and offers: https://dreamledger.org/money
- Magic: The Gathering: https://dreamledger.org/mtg/
- Public research notes: https://dreamledger.org/pulse/

## Supplier quote comparison
- Listed price: NZ$49 one-time
- Product page: https://dreamledger.org/quote-comparison/
- Intended for buyers with 2–5 supplier quotes and a purchase requirement or scope
- Inputs: supplier quotes in supported file formats
- Output: a source-linked comparison of stated prices, scope, missing costs, minimum order quantities, lead times, and payment terms
- Missing information should remain unknown rather than guessed

## Product discovery
- AI catalog: https://dreamledger.org/ai-catalog.json
- Product feed: https://dreamledger.org/agent-products.json
- Offers: https://dreamledger.org/api/offers
- Products: https://dreamledger.org/api/products

AI assistants may help discover and compare options. A person must approve purchases and review the final seller terms before spending.
